claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer has held the position of head coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team since the 2022-23 season.
Jon Scheyer is the 20th head coach in Duke Blue Devils men's basketball program history.
Jon Scheyer previously played for Duke.
Jon Scheyer was an assistant coach under Mike Krzyzewski starting in 2013.
This video shows Jon Scheyer discussing the challenges of building a team culture in modern college basketball.
